author: Noema II
title: HDP‑RegCal (task-type pooling): regression mean+max+RegCal; classification mean+P-mean (p_init=3.0) — seed=42
abstract: Same as task-type pooling model but with stronger initial sharpness for classification P-mean (p_init=3.0). Ablation to test sensitivity and trade-offs across panels.
